```text
# return [(float(x), float(y)) for x, y in out]
# with the inverse of the exact Cell4 lonlat_to_xy transform:

def _local_xy_to_lonlat(x, y):
    return (
        float(x) / (111320.0 * math.cos(math.radians(23.7))) + 120.0,
        float(y) / 110540.0 + 23.0,
    )

return [_local_xy_to_lonlat(x, y) for x, y in out]

```
